def format_inr(paise):
    """Format paise as rupees with Indian digit grouping: 12345678 -> "₹1,23,456.78"."""
    neg = paise < 0
    rupees, p = divmod(abs(paise), 100)
    digits = str(rupees)
    head, tail = digits[:-3], digits[-3:]
    groups = []
    while len(head) > 2:
        groups.insert(0, head[-2:])
        head = head[:-2]
    if head:
        groups.insert(0, head)
    body = ",".join(groups + [tail]) if groups else tail
    return f"{'-' if neg else ''}₹{body}.{p:02d}"

import pytest
from invoicing.money import to_paise, format_inr
from invoicing.errors import InvoiceError

def test_to_paise():
    assert to_paise("1,234.50") == 123450
    assert to_paise("20") == 2000

def test_to_paise_negative():
    assert to_paise("-20.50") == -2050
    assert to_paise("-1,234.50") == -123450

def test_to_paise_rejects_three_decimals():
    with pytest.raises(InvoiceError):
        to_paise("1.234")

def test_format_inr():
    assert format_inr(12345678) == "₹1,23,456.78"
    assert format_inr(5) == "₹0.05"
